candidates.requirement: Decode a valid PNG containing gAMA with SPNG_DECODE_USE_GAMA so the changed lookup table is populated and used.
candidates.target_route: The entry supplies PNG bytes, calculates RGBA8 output size, then calls spng_decode_image.
candidates.failure_condition: The call always passes SPNG_DECODE_USE_TRNS (1), which does not set SPNG_DECODE_USE_GAMA (2); no input can enter either guarded gamma block.
candidates.alternative_paths: A gAMA chunk sets stored_gama but cannot change the call's flags. The separate library tests that enable gamma are outside this fuzz target.
